theorems.name: Submission.codim1_deformation_minimal_hypercone_is_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 2 ≤ m → m ≤ 6 → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M.Nonempty → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsOrientation m M ξ) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ tsupport Z → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → ∃ H₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m ∧ M = (H₀ : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}
